blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) App Connector version.
This App Connector version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released for the App Connector Manager Software to support App Connector deployment on the Red Hat OpenShift Platform.
An update was released to update the modsecurity library to version 3.0.10 and the PCRE library to version to 8.45.
An update was released to further improve the effectiveness of the current troubleshooting procedures available to customers.

blocks.text: Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
A recommended update was released that includes:

blocks.item: Updated App Connector and ZPA Private Service Edge RPM packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.x and 8.x.
Support for App Connector deployment on the Red Hat OpenShift Platform.

blocks.text: To learn more, see Understanding the Manager Software.
This App Connector version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released to support Active Directory (AD) Protection inspection for protocol traffic (Kerberos, SMB, and LDAP). To learn more, see Active Directory Protection.
An update was released that includes internal ZDX caching optimizations.
An update was released to provide support for ZDX cloud path optimizations for private applications. To learn more, see ZDX Cloud Path Optimizations.
An update was released to provide support for AppProtection log enhancements.

blocks.text: Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
This App Connector version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released for the App Connector Manager Software to support the full list of OS trusted certificate authority (CA) bundles for updating components.
An update was released for App Connectors to resolve wildcard CNAME records.
An update was released for App Connectors to provide support for an event triggered by CPU starvation. To learn more, see Viewing and Managing Events Diagnostics.

An update was released for App Connectors to provide support for an event when the control connection disconnects for App Connectors. To learn more, see Viewing and Managing Events Diagnostics and Configuring Notifications.
An update was released for App Connectors to support alternative cloud domains. To learn more, see Alternative Cloud Domain.

blocks.text: Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
This App Connector version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An optional update was released for the App Connector Manager software based on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 to support Zscaler Branch Connector.
An update was released for App Connectors that requires admins to change the default password.

blocks.text: Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
This App Connector version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released for App Connectors that provides support for the backup and management of disaster recovery configuration and binary snapshots. Debugging commands were also released for disaster recovery troubleshooting. To learn more, see About Disaster Recovery App Connector Groups, Managing Disaster Recovery Configuration and Binary Snapshots, and Troubleshooting App Connectors.
A fix was released to address an issue where the App Connector IP for UDP connections was not correctly displayed on the Diagnostics pages.

blocks.text: Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
This App Connector version includes a fix to address an OpenSSL vulnerability.
Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.
A recommended update was released for the App Connector Manager Software to address an OpenSSL vulnerability. To learn more, see About the Manager Software.
This App Connector version includes an optional update for the App Connector Manager software to support internal Zscaler-only cloud configurations. To learn more, see About the Manager Service.
Your App Connectors will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per App Connector group. To learn more, see About App Connector Software Updates.

blocks.item: A fix was released to address an issue where the App Connector port was not correctly displayed on the Diagnostic pages.
An update was released that provides support for Zscaler ThreatLabZ controls. To learn more, see ThreatLabZ Controls.
An update was released that provides support for Privileged Remote Access to VNC consoles. To learn more, see Virtual Network Computing.
